confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Chiang Mai price levels, not live listings. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by season and location, and the July green-season window is assumed to sit at the lower end. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer, since direct knowledge of bar prices is weaker. The FX observation comes from search results that report the RBA page value, and I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asian basis, using second-tier Thai tourist cities and northern Thailand price levels as the reference for food, drinks and budget-to-mid accommodation.
